description: A C# game engine in which a program opens a window, draws each frame with plain static calls named as raylib's functions are, and draws Dear ImGui in the same frame, over SDL3, Vulkan and Slang, with an ECS and source-generated behaviors underneath.
releaseNotes:
A ray crossing leaves keeps its reach where it stopped and the merge sees the probes above past the leaves, so a floor under a canopy past the screen probes' reach takes the sky light the leaves let through.
A mesh entity's material takes every default a model's material takes, a roughness of a half and the faces' fronts alone drawn among them.
The model pass draws a view's opaque batches by their pipeline and nearest first within it, which takes the voxel game's sections drawn through DrawMesh from about 13.6 to about 8.7 ms of the scene pass in its grove at 1080p High.
title: 3DEngine
